repository. I read the diff to the end, including the read receipt WITNESS-READ 86d8d2b4297265d7. I found three problems, all in
stats.py:
1. Wrong result for even-length lists: it returns the upper of the two middle values. For example, median([1, 2, 3, 4]) gives 3
instead of 2.5.
2. Empty list: median([]) raises IndexError, but mean([]) raises ZeroDivisionError. The two functions handle empty input differently.
3. No tests: nothing checks odd length, even length, a single element, unsorted input or an empty list.
